body:
Subtitle output could disappear or leave backing intrusions when worker evidence was incomplete, source frames repeated, or proof work exhausted its allowance. This change preserves private recovery state while requiring current native glyph, companion and backing evidence for displayed replacement and cleanup. Fixed picture geometry and raw aspect-ratio authority retain their existing rules.

Candidate: 13dc7bb0cc3c195035ed0f41fc81e0f749460685, based on current beta v1.4.02-beta at b1415da4e2cc12807f390f4b722c459be9a17c08.

- Complete current proofs can continue independently of unrelated picture measurements. Exact current sample reuse and qualified complete worker evidence avoid redundant work without narrowing configured companion coverage.
- Complete inspection takes priority over optional pending work when worker evidence is unavailable. Reproduced wide-cue cases complete proof and cap cleanup within the unchanged 524,288 whole-frame read allowance. Complete contradictions cannot promote old pending cues.
- Exact source repeats revalidate pixels without discarding pending recovery or renewing its original lease. Budget-only failure retains private candidates; contradiction, expiry and context changes still retire them. Finite wide backing has its separately bounded 131,072 phase allowance.
- Subtitle metadata binds to the actual immutable GPU packet. Reusable heap output storage, immutable reset defaults and a temporary fallback tracker avoid the reproduced renderer stack overflow while preserving owner release and admission rules. Thread stack reserves are unchanged.
- Padded subtitle bounds can cross the picture edge while every actual glyph line remains in the bar. After the original masked plane check fails, this specific case can use exact current native edge proof. Every accepted line must lie wholly in its cue bar. The complete configured search, slot/ink checks and separate current backing proof still follow. No read limits or holds change in this correction.

Validation: clean matching x64 Release host, standard/beta renderers and test DLL; **1964/1964 selected native/GPU regressions passed**, including all three preserved native captures. All 21 new methods since 6f0c02b2 passed. Runtime identities, 18 dependency hashes, actual DLL/PDB stack allocations and the test-only probe source/hash/PE contract are verified.

Seven new full-path regressions cover both bars and configured near distances, missing worker output, exact applied cap geometry, false glyph-supplied boundaries, original crossing support, changed pixels, companion rejection and incomplete-budget recovery. The reproduced 26-glyph two-line case uses 449,672 reads below the unchanged 524,288 ceiling (top mirror 451,016). Wider acquisition limits remain conservative; detector association distance still limits which nearby picture glyphs belong to the cue. No universal large-cue or hard CPU deadline claim.

Interim 43fb6cba passed tests but FAILED actual host startup with stack overflow and was rolled back. Its preserved dump identified the unavailable-preview reset chain. The repaired isolated child runs all five paths, including the new exact-plane/cap path, at a real 1 MiB reserve with 783,808 bytes of caller pressure. The test helper is not deployed. Parent host startup and playback remain separate gates.

Offscreen D3D11 tests cover repeats, failure/recovery and simulated 24-to-60/23.976-to-59.94 timestamps; they do not qualify physical display cadence, HDR brightness or private RenderLocked. The previous installed 3ecab879 ran through 02:56:42 with 758 valid/applied cap checks and zero logged subtitle transitions or geometry events in the settled stationary window; concurrent probes prevent treating that window as an isolated performance baseline.

Authorized test deployment is installed with all three loaded module hashes verified and original configuration restored. The same host survived 229.8 seconds, responsive, with no Windows crash/hang events. Settled stationary observation 2026-10-24 03:19:20 through 2026-10-24 03:22:52 contains 107 valid/applied cap records and zero subtitle stability events, pixel contradictions or submitted geometry changes. Clear/Yellow remains active; source/display remain matched near 23.976 Hz. This qualifies startup and sampled stationary behavior only.

**Keep DRAFT and UNMERGED.** Prior 398034da failed user Ben-Hur replay. Actual moving Ben-Hur, visual acceptance and physical mismatched-refresh qualification remain pending. The new padded-envelope defect is reproduced in controlled native fixtures; it is not established as the cause of the recorded incident. Stationary logs and automated tests cannot establish visual resolution. VP-0207 holds receipts; movie pixels, dump, full logs/TRX and binaries remain outside Git.
